notes.title: First Operator of the Week + Update
notes.content:
Attention NanoHive Operators, the first Operator of the Week has been chosen and a new software update for the Operator Control Panel was released. The Operator of the Week is none other than one of the Founders, tomi. 

It seems like nobody was able to beat the Founder challenge, but worry not, there is still time. As the name suggests, a new Operator of the Week will be chosen every Monday. And the first non Founder to claim the title will become a part of the game credits for all to see.  

As for the software update. Now you can see all leaderboard entries both in the menu and after completing a decontamination procedure. The new layout also includes the ranking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42910981/17f10b2a3c731d7a01723751cdfc08c0539c410d.png

Furthermore, after the procedure is complete the leaderboard will highlight your placement. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42910981/2f4047b8a4f66660afab696eeaa18766908447ca.png

Thank you all for your efforts, more updates coming soon.

If you are interested in joining our community on the Discord server you can click this link or press the Discord button in the main menu. Discord

notes.title: NanoHive Operator of the Week + Post Launch Hotfix
notes.content:
We want to thank everybody new NanoHive Operator for their support in delivering a fast decontamination procedure and curing the brain Cancer of their patients. 

We want further to incentivise the competition between Operators on the global leaderboard and in order to do that we are introducing the Operator of the Week Programme. 

Every week on Monday the best Operator in at least four out of the seven different areas on the global leaderboard will be shown on all pages of the leaderboard to the other Operators. They will also receive a unique role in the Discord server if they are part of it. In addition to all of this, the first Operator of the Week will become a part of the game credits for all to see the person who will start this tradition.

Currently, the first rank in all areas is held by the Founders (tomi, Radu, You know... or Yes) so we would like to challenge all Operators to take those top spots away from us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42910981/5674c5d7c97c6393a4d8dff4dbc85ffa3d06930d.png

We also want to let you all know that there have been some software fixes to the NanoBots and to the Operator Control Panel, specifically you can now see what rank you would have after submitting your disinfection time or wave (unless you already have submitted a better one). 

We were let know by the Operators in our Discord server that there are some mistakes that need changing. There has also been a change inside the Lungs, it seems that the parasites have been replaced by viruses (we wonder if this has to do with anything).

Thank you all again for your support and we can't wait to see who will take over the role of Operator of the Week.
